description: The pins of every repository's shared workflows live here. Updates come on the 1st and the 15th, grouped, and wait for review: a change here reaches every caller once Renovate moves its pin there, and the Renovate and release workflows only run on the callers' main.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes come at once, outside the schedule.

customManagers.description: The Renovate version every repository runs: the renovate-version input's default.
The zizmor version every repository runs: the version input's default.

packageRules.description: zizmor-action only installs the zizmor versions it has a lock file for, so they move together; the zizmor job in test.yml runs the result.
